## Problem

What problem does this change address, and why does it matter?

## Approach

Describe the implementation and important trade-offs.

## Evidence and validation

List exact tests, checks, benchmarks, datasets, or source references and their results.

## Risks and boundaries

Describe compatibility, security, privacy, scientific-claim, licensing, or migration risks.

## Checklist

- [ ] I reviewed the diff and removed unrelated changes.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests and documentation.
- [ ] I separated verified results from interpretation or aspiration.
- [ ] I checked provenance and redistribution rights for external material.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, or restricted research material.
